If the nim-sum is non-zero, I'll try reducing each pile to its target value (computed via XOR with the nim-sum) and verify the resulting position is losing. When that fails, I'll attempt to transition into the endgame by reducing piles down to either 1 or 0 object, checking if those positions are losing states.

If no winning move emerges from these strategies, I'll just remove one object from the first non-empty pile as a fallback.
